messages:
Priya (Finance): @channel Starting 15 Jul 2026 were rolling out a billing credit smoothing change: instead of uneven intra-month credit lumps, customers will receive a consistent monthly credit allotment. This should make invoices and quotas more predictable.

Priya (Finance): Key points: total annual credits unchanged; credits will be evenly distributed across months. Cutover: 2026-07-15 UTC. Well offer a 14-day rollback window for accounts materially affected and an automatic temporary 25% cushion for accounts flagged as high-burst for the first two cycles.

Marco (Billing): Dev ops: conversion = floor(annual_total/12) with remainder added to month 1. We will emit invoice.credit_smoothing.v1 at cutover. Need a preview CSV by 2026-06-25 listing accounts where new_monthly_amount deviates >35% from median usage. Include rollback_flag and burst_score.

Tess (Product): Comms plan: 1) console banner + email two weeks prior, 2) in-console simulator so customers can preview impact, 3) early opt-in program. Draft copy will be posted to #product-comms.

Aisha (Support): Support playbook: - Escalate if customer sees >10% invoice delta to #billing-escalations. - Use migration-preview tool to check rollback eligibility. - If rollback requested within 14 days, open ticket and cc legal. Training scheduled 2026-07-07.

Darren (Legal): Rollback is one-time per account and requires a brief electronic acknowledgement. Rollback may be restricted if account has reserved capacity; sales must approve. Ill provide succinct legal language for the email footer.

Priya (Finance): Cushion rules: 25% cushion is an invoice credit (not cash) applied automatically for two billing cycles to accounts classified as high-burst. Not retroactive.

ops-billing-bot: queued_preview_emails: 129 -> scheduled 2026-07-01T09:00:00Z

Tess (Product): Console preview snippet:

"From 15 July 2026 we will smooth annual credits into a steady monthly allotment. Your yearly credits remain the same. Preview your converted monthly amount and estimated invoice impact. If needed, request rollback within 14 days after your cutover."

Marco (Billing): Sample support reply:

"Hi <customer>, we smoothed annual credits into equal monthly allotments on 15 Jul. Your account shows a [+/- X%] change vs prior month. We can open a rollback request within 14 days. Please share last 3 months usage to speed review. — Marco"

Priya (Finance): Timeline recap: - 2026-06-25: preview CSV to teams - 2026-07-01: preview emails + banner - 2026-07-15: cutover and event emission - 14-day rollback window post-cutover. Safety: if >0.4% of active accounts request rollback in 48h, we pause rollout for 24h and investigate.

Aisha (Support): :thumbsup: will prep training deck and sample tickets.

Priya (Finance): Action items: Marco -> preview CSV by 2026-06-25; Eng -> preview API + console simulator by 2026-07-01; Support -> training and intake form by 2026-07-07; Legal -> final email copy by 2026-06-20.
